GmailLabel.description:
A Gmail label resource.

Labels are used to categorize messages and threads within the
user's mailbox.

color.description: The color of the label; only available for user labels.

id.description: The immutable id of the label.

labelListVisibility.description: The visibility of the label in the label list.

messageListVisibility.description: The visibility of messages with this label in the message list.

messagesTotal.description: The total number of messages with the label.

messagesUnread.description: The number of unread messages with the label.

name.description: The display name of the label.

threadsTotal.description: The total number of threads with the label.

threadsUnread.description: The number of unread threads with the label.

type.description: The owner type of the label, serialized as `type`.

GmailLabelColor.description: Text and background colors of a user label, given as hex strings.

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the label as a hex string.

textColor.description: The text color of the label as a hex string.

GmailLabelListVisibility.description: Visibility of the label in the label list of the Gmail web client.

oneOf.description: The label always shows in the label list.
The label shows in the label list only when unread.
The label never shows in the label list.

GmailLabelType.description: Owner of the label: created by Gmail or by the user.

oneOf.description: A label created by Gmail, like INBOX or TRASH.
A label created by the user.

GmailMessageListVisibility.description: Whether messages carrying a label show up in the message list.

oneOf.description: Messages with the label show in the message list.
Messages with the label are hidden from the message list.
